blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Higher Education & Universities
blocks.note: The flow is linear on purpose: every hop owns its latency budget and failure policy, and a regression in one stage is a cohort, never an estate-wide surprise.

blocks.x: Every component in Higher Education & Universities has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.
